description: Replace the content of a record in the selected Vault. Requires update permission. Send the record ID, the complete new English content and expected_revision, the revision from your latest read. The new content replaces the old, so keep every detail that still holds. Changed content is processed again, so the record can show processing status. The previous version remains restorable for 30 days.

content.description: The complete replacement content in English. It replaces the current content, so include every detail that still holds.

expected_revision.description: The revision from your latest read of this record. Reread after a conflict; never guess.

id.description: Record ID in the selected Vault.

name: ragionex_update_memory
title: Update a memory record
